name: veyvo-mobile
description: VEYVO Android and iOS apps (Capacitor wrapper around ../src)

scripts.build:debug: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.sync:play: node scripts/sync-web.mjs --channel play && cap sync android
scripts.build:github:apk: node scripts/sync-web.mjs --channel github && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:play:aab: node scripts/sync-web.mjs --channel play && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.sync:ios: node scripts/sync-web.mjs --channel appstore && cap sync ios && node scripts/ios-version.mjs
